name: wmkf_appreviewersuggestion-ended-by
_comment: Additive initiator record for an invited reviewer's outcome (docs/plans/INVITED_REVIEWER_OUTCOMES_PLAN_2026-10-31.md). Records who ended the engagement, not who typed it. Null means no one ended it (an open engagement, a lapsed invitation, or a row written before this field existed). Run scripts/preflight-reviewer-outcomes-schema.mjs before the creation-only schema applier; an exact manually-created field is an expected no-op.

attributes.description: Who ended this reviewer engagement: the reviewer before accepting, the reviewer after accepting, or the Foundation. This records who initiated the ending, not who recorded it. Empty when no one ended it, including a lapsed invitation.
